target: HelpfulnessNumerator / HelpfulnessDenominator for valid positive-denominator vote records
text_model: Ridge regression, alpha=1.0, structured features plus TF-IDF unigrams and bigrams

bootstrap.method: Product-cluster bootstrap; resample products with replacement and retain all evaluated reviews per draw.

interpretation_note: Positive MAE reduction favors the text-enhanced model. The bootstrap p-value is an empirical one-sided tail estimate, not an exact test. The confidence interval describes uncertainty in the review-weighted mean paired MAE reduction under product-level resampling. The target is a noisy review-level helpfulness proportion, and the analysis is predictive rather than causal.
